items.quote: And Moses called unto them; and Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation returned unto him: and Moses talked with them.
items.claim: Moses called to the people; Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation came back to him, and Moses spoke with them.
items.object: Aaron and all the rulers of the congregation
items.mechanism: Moses called them, and the leaders came back to talk with him (the text gives no reason for the call).
